ruleDefinitions.name: Rundll32 Spawned Via Explorer.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "rundll32.exe" with a parent process of Explorer.exe. This has been observed by variants of Raspberry Robin, as first reported by Red Canary.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-localserver\\ 22d8c27b\\-47a1\\-48d1\\-ad08\\-7da7abd79617$")))
